payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_cli.py::test_every_command_pushes_the_facts_it_appended_before_it_exits stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/cli.py. The claim was "`saffron`'s entry point pushes every key the command appended before it returns or raises. The witness drives each of the twelve commands it dispatches over its shared `Ledger` on a return: `cell`, `batch`, `draft`, `queue`, `reconcile`, `regate`, `review`, `adopt`, `package`, `finish`, `chains` and `replay`. `adopt` returns 1 and the rest 0. It drives a SIGTERM read as exit 143 on `batch`, which `_guarding_sigterm` wraps. It drives a raise read as exit 2 on `finish`, which it wraps, and on `reconcile`, which it does not. It drives a `KeyboardInterrupt` that leaves `main` on `regate`, which it wraps, and on `queue`, which it does not. In each the origin holds the command's fact. Each return, raise and SIGTERM exits with the command's own code. In the two `KeyboardInterrupt` cases the witness asserts the interrupt propagates out of `main`, as `_guarding_sigterm` re-raises it (`saffron/cli.py:590-593`).", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
